caseName: Dunbar-Dukate Co. v. Celeste Sugar Co.
caseNameFull: Dunbar-Dukate Company, Incorporated v. The Celeste Sugar Company, Incorporated
attorneys: Messrs. Rush L. Holland, George E. Strong and C. F. Borah for defendant in error in support of the motion. Messrs. John Dymond, A. Griffin Levy and James Wilkinson for plaintiff in error in opposition thereto...

opinions.text:
Per Curiam '.

The motion to substitute party for defendant in error is denied for the reason that the absence of a substantial federal question requires the Court to grant the motion to dismiss on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
